items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Johnny Bystorfer got sick for about three weeks. So Tommy takes the trumpet and plays the big show.

ctx.x: Yeah, you knew him. All right. Johnny Bystorfer got sick for about three weeks. So Tommy takes the trumpet and plays the big show. I can believe it. A beautiful trumpet. Oh man. I said, how in the hell can you play trumpet and take the trumpet? He used to like the trombones. He wanted to play trombone. But he used to play that show, cut that show like that.
He sounded like Joe Olive on trumpet to me. Some of the records. He sounded like Joe Olive on trumpet. No. Somebody could play Rattie on trumpet.
